text: The 'Sardegna' branding on the Cagliari front shirt is the tourism promotion of the Autonomous Region of Sardinia, run by its regional tourism department (Assessorato del Turismo, Artigianato e Commercio), which has repeatedly signed main-sponsor deals with the club. It is a public-law regional body. The shirt front is co-branded with Sardinian craft-beer chain Doppio Malto, a private company.
short: The 'Sardegna' branding on the Cagliari front shirt is the tourism promotion of the Autonomous Region of Sardinia, run by its regional tourism department….
